newsitem.title: POLAND: Stalexport to issue $50 mln eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Stalexport to issue $50 mln eurobonds.

text.p: Polish steel trader Stalexport SA plans to issue 50,000 five-to-seven-year convertible eurobonds at a par value of $1,000, directed to foreign investors, the company said in a statement.
Stalexport said it wanted to list the bonds on the London Stock Exchange.
It said it also wanted to issue up to four million shares ex rights to be exchanged for the bonds.

It said the bonds would carry a fixed annual coupon of up to five percent and would be redeemed at par plus a coupon equal to the interest on five or seven-year U.S. treasury bond plus 125-175 basis points.
The bonds could be exchanged for the shares six months after the issue at the earliest, it said.
The shares would be converted at the average price of the shares during three sessions before the issue plus a premium of at least 15 percent in dollar terms.
Stalexport also said the bonds would be callable after three years at par value plus a coupon equal to the interest on comparable five or seven year U.S. treasury bonds plus 125-175 basis points.
The convertible bonds and new shares have yet to be approved by the extraordinary shareholders meeting on December 21.
